verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe onboarding sellers and having Adyen verify them before paying out. This glancingly matches the pattern of letting sellers start first and completing verification before payout. Hosted and API-only onboarding flows plus the Legal Entity Management API show onboarding is product-native, but nothing documents tunable minimum-data tiers, payout-threshold-triggered requirements, or per-seller requirements-due states. missing for 10: configurable/tiered onboarding requirements, payout or volume thresholds that trigger additional data collection, per-seller requirements-due/status visibility, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller

citations.quote: onboard sellers, service providers, or contractors on to your platform, and let Adyen verify them before paying out

Hosted onboarding: Direct your users to a page hosted by Adyen, where Adyen manages the onboarding flow and user interface (UI)... API-only onboarding: Build your own UI and collect required user data.
